name: 冰薄荷清新牙膏口腔护理款
description: 冰薄荷绿视觉，含浴室场景、空白参数对照表与四宫格规格分栏

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, iced mint green #BFE3CE panels for benefit and scene screens, matte stone surfaces #EDF2EF for infographics, dense fresh mint leaf bed #2F5B3F for overhead nature screens; one frosted translucent rounded card carries every information layer
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool bright high-key studio light, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadows only, sweeping rim highlight along the tube shoulder, dappled leaf shadows in scene and overhead screens, 5500K in bathroom scenes
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte stone bathroom counter #EDF2EF, pale sage ceramic tile #BFE3CE, frosted glass shelf and rounded card, fresh mint foliage #2F5B3F
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for every label, one italic serif accent allowed only for a single emphasis word in a headline; headline and label copy always supplied as placeholders
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in charcoal #33383D, rounded hexagon tags and frosted rounded cards, no chemical structure diagrams, no filled tick or cross marks, no certification seals
styleLock.presentationRules: tube stands on its flip-top cap with the label facing camera, stable scale and slight 3/4 to straight-on hero angle across the set, paste ribbon prop used only as a background sweep, every spec cell and badge left as an empty placeholder
noDrift: no filled-in numbers, dates, units or badge wording
no invented ingredient, efficacy or clinical claims
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean fresh mint oral-care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, matte stone #EDF2EF, iced mint green #BFE3CE and deep leaf green #2F5B3F with charcoal text #33383D; cool bright high-key studio lighting with a front-left key, soft fill, soft contact shadows and a sweeping rim highlight; modern geometric sans-serif with one italic serif accent for a single emphasis word; thin single-weight line icons and rounded hexagon tags; frosted translucent rounded cards as the only information layer; tube presented standing on its flip-top cap with the label facing camera and stable scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no filled-in spec numbers or badge wording.

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼赢得点击，主体轮廓干净且平台合规
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, tube upright on its flip-top cap, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.props: one sculpted paste ribbon sweeping behind the tube, one mint sprig at the base, one empty rounded hexagon tag
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace beyond equal clean margins
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The tube standing upright on its flip-top cap, straight-on eye-level view, full product visible and centered in the frame. A smooth sculpted ribbon of paste sweeps diagonally behind the tube and one fresh mint sprig rests near the base as the only prop. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the cap. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace beyond equal clean margins. One empty rounded hexagon tag floats beside the tube shoulder carrying no words. 8K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no added headline text, no words inside the hexagon tag, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no decorative confetti, no gradient or tinted background, no cut-off cap, no duplicated paste ribbon.

shots.intent: 用一条主张说清首要购买理由，落实主图一秒法则
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, product placed on the left third
shots.lighting: soft front-left key with gentle fill, sweeping rim highlight along the tube shoulder, soft contact shadow
shots.background: iced mint green #BFE3CE panel band on clean white #FFFFFF
shots.props: one paste ribbon behind the product, one mint sprig, one frosted rounded headline panel
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 40% for copy
shots.textZone: frosted rounded panel at the top right
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The tube standing upright at a slight 3/4 hero angle on the left of the frame, occupying 50-60%. A sculpted paste ribbon curves behind it and one mint sprig lies at the base. Soft front-left key light with gentle fill, a sweeping rim highlight along the tube shoulder, soft contact shadow. Background of one iced mint green #BFE3CE panel band over clean white #FFFFFF. shots.intent: 用齿间与膏体微距交代使用动作与质地，替代不可验证的功效表述
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a low side profile angle, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: cool soft studio light from the upper left with a skimming highlight across the enamel, no harsh speculars
shots.background: fresh mint leaf bed in deep leaf green #2F5B3F filling the lower third
shots.props: one toothbrush carrying a bead of paste, fresh mint leaves, one sculpted paste ribbon
shots.whitespace: minimal whitespace, the texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of a bright natural smile with a toothbrush resting across the teeth while a bead of paste from {product} sits on the brush head, tight zoom on the mouth line. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a low side profile angle at macro distance with shallow depth of field, the front teeth row sharp and anatomically correct, lips and cheek skin showing real pores and fine texture. Cool soft studio light from the upper left with a skimming highlight travelling across the enamel, no harsh speculars. The lower third of the frame is filled with fresh mint leaves in deep leaf green #2F5B3F and one sculpted paste ribbon in clean white #FFFFFF. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace because the texture is the subject. Negative: no deformed or extra teeth, no fused fingers, no identifiable face, no added text or ingredient lists, no plastic skin, no exaggerated shade contrast, no watermark.

shots.lighting: soft even high-key studio light from the front-left, identical on both halves, soft contact shadows
shots.background: frosted glass shelf over a clean white ledge #FFFFFF
shots.props: translucent table panel with empty placeholder cells, two floating hexagon column tags
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the upper left for the question headline
shots.textZone: upper left headline zone plus five row labels and two column headers
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison infographic at straight-on eye level, two versions of {product} standing side by side on a frosted glass shelf above a two-column comparison table. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The table is a clean five-row by two-column grid drawn with charcoal #33383D hairlines on a translucent panel over a clean white ledge #FFFFFF; every header and data cell holds only an empty placeholder bar, tick and cross glyph slots stay as empty outlines, and the two column headers carry label placeholders reading 「{callout_3}」 and 「{callout_4}」. Soft even high-key studio light falling from the front-left, identical on both halves so only the product state differs, soft contact shadows under each tube. The two products occupy 50-60% of the frame together, generous negative space across the upper left for the question headline. Negative: no filled-in numbers, no ingredient percentages, no named competitor, no trademark marks, no fabricated test data or ratings, no dense body text, no watermark.

Each quadrant shows {product} in a different pack arrangement, single standing tube, a standing cluster, a tube beside its carton and a tube beside a canvas pouch, all on a matte stone counter #EDF2EF with a sage folded towel, a soap dish and a potted fern, the label facing camera in every panel. One frosted label bar sits along the bottom edge of each quadrant holding a single line placeholder reading 「{callout_5}」. Soft bright daylight from the left at 5500K with gentle contact shadows and consistent exposure across all four panels. The products occupy 50-60% overall, equal gutters between panels and no extra whitespace. Negative: no size or capacity numbers, no travel or security approval wording, no lighting drift between panels, no duplicated product inside one panel, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：01 白底竖立软管＋膏体拉丝飘带＋一枚空六边形吊牌；02 手持牙刷与软管、左下大字主张的浴室半身场景；03 台面斜放软管＋磨砂透明卡叠三枚原料样片与说明行；04 薄荷叶床正俯视，软管居右、磨砂卡内五行线性图标加标签；05 四宫格规格选择（单支／多支组合／带彩盒／带收纳袋），每格底部磨砂标签条；06 五支不同色带软管一字排开、上方五枚深色六边形吊牌；07 两支软管并排＋下方五行两列参数对照表；08 齿间与牙刷微距，下半屏薄荷叶床叠一大段原料文字。品类判定：图示为挤出式软管口腔清洁品，用刷牙动作与齿间特写说明，属护理清洁而非着色，故取 L1 护肤个护 / L2 口腔护理，与源类目路径一致；未改判。已剥离内容：品牌字标与系列名、包装上全部文字、原料名称与配方机理及功效／临床说明、清单条目具体项、规格容量数字与出行安检字样、对照表全部单元格内容与勾叉、模特身份与面容（改为颈部以下裁切）、平台角标与星级社会证明；图内文字一律换成空白占位行或 {callout_n}/{selling_point_n}，源 06 的暖米背景按套内色锁统一改为 #BFE3CE 以保持冷调一致。
